source.description: Computes a add edit on an existing JSX/HTML attribute; the shared DOM engine writes the modified file.
Computes a add edit on an existing JSX/HTML class; the shared DOM engine writes the modified file.
Computes a add edit on an existing JSX/HTML data-area; the shared DOM engine writes the modified file.
The shared DOM engine implements add-element. It constructs markup or edits existing ranges; there is no local template file.
